canonical_project: Stargate UAE / UAE-US Global AI Campus
owner: G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, SoftBank and partners
notes: G42 official announcement: 1 GW Stargate cluster as first phase of a 5 GW UAE-US AI Campus in Abu Dhabi. Division mapping is uncertain: Data Center Map places the project on Hameem Road (Al Dhafra region) while dcpulse (2025-12-23) reports construction-phase launch in KEZAD. Mapped to Al Dhafra per Hameem Road lead with low mapping confidence; capacity 1000 MW records the first-phase Stargate cluster, campus build-out is 5 GW.
